summary: Mandatory prior permission to drill deep borewells or tubewells to extract groundwater.

steps.title: Verify groundwater notification zone
steps.description: Check whether property falls in 'Safe', 'Semi-Critical', or 'Over-Exploited/Notified' zone.

steps.title: Submit hydrogeological report
steps.description: Upload hydrogeological feasibility report prepared by accredited groundwater consultant.

steps.title: Submit online application on CGWA portal
steps.description: Attach property land ownership documents, water requirement calculation, and flow meter proposal.

steps.title: District advisory committee scrutiny
steps.description: District Ground Water Cell scrutinizes non-availability of piped water supply before granting permit.

steps.title: Drilling permission with telemetry condition
steps.description: Obtain formal drilling permit with mandatory condition of installing tamper-proof digital flow meter.
